# Minimum / ranged requirements.
#
# Use this ONLY when requirements_lock.txt cannot be installed -- typically when
# the machine runs a different Python minor version for which the exact pinned
# versions have no binary wheel, or when pip has to resolve a slightly newer
# patch release.
#
# Lower bounds are not arbitrary:
#   numpy >= 1.22   numpy.quantile(..., method="inverted_cdf") is required by the
#                   locked threshold rule; the `method=` keyword does not exist
#                   before 1.22.
#   scipy >= 1.7    scipy.special.logsumexp / scipy.spatial.distance.cdist
#   scikit-learn >= 1.0   KernelDensity and LocalOutlierFactor(novelty=True)
#   matplotlib >= 3.5, pandas >= 1.3   figures and CSV output
#
# If you end up on this file, RECORD the versions you actually got:
#     .venv\Scripts\python.exe env\freeze_env.py
# and copy the resulting requirements_lock.txt into your own run log.

numpy>=1.22,<3
scipy>=1.7,<2
scikit-learn>=1.0,<2
matplotlib>=3.5,<4
pandas>=1.3,<4
